notes: Phobos Manufacturing materials: raw stock with real consumers, terminal remainders at the technical minimum price, and mined chunks that clone the game's hydrates. Owner decisions of 29 September 2026; the recovery rules are in docs/development/manufacturing-refinery-and-chemistry.md, and the prices follow the refining business rules the owner approved on 1 October 2026 (docs/development/refining-business-and-interdependencies.md). Kinds: stock clones the game's scrap steel, mined clones its hydrates. A material's kg is bound to the recipes that use it: change both or neither.

PhobosNickelIronIngot.notes: Cast nickel-iron, Manufacturing raw stock: 55 cr/kg, so the meteoric iron charge earns about twice its ore (refining as a business, owner approval 1 October 2026); four plus one carbon stock carburise into four nickel steel ingots.

PhobosCarbonStock.notes: Carbon stock from the carbides charge: 38 cr, so the carbon ore charge earns about twice its ore (1 October 2026).

PhobosRefinerySlag.notes: Terminal: sulfide, phosphide and oxide skimmings, a carburising melt's carbon dross, or a frozen melt.

PhobosClayHydrates.notes: Mined, never sold: a CI-type clay hydrate chunk from C-class finds. Uses the game's hydrate art until it has its own.

PhobosAmmoniumSaltCrust.notes: Mined, never sold: ammonium chloride and sodium carbonate crust of the kind NASA's Dawn mission saw on Ceres; sells like the game's hydrates.

PhobosSpentSaltCake.notes: Terminal: sodium chloride baked into the crust's clay.

PhobosEvaporiteCrust.notes: Mined, never sold: an evaporite-rich piece of a brine vein from C-class finds, after the minerals NASA's OSIRIS-REx team reported in Bennu samples (McCoy et al. 2025); proportions authored. Sells like the game's hydrates.

PhobosPotassiumSulfate.notes: LC-3 product, about 271 cr/kg: fertiliser-grade potassium sulfate; with the phosphate concentrate the evaporite charge earns twice its crust (1 October 2026). Never sold by merchants.

PhobosPhosphateConcentrate.notes: LC-3 intermediate, 440 cr/kg: the crust's wet-separated Na,Mg phosphate, feed for struvite. Phosphorus is the scarce crop nutrient (1 October 2026). Never sold by merchants.

PhobosLeachedResidue.notes: LC-3 intermediate at the technical minimum price: the crust's clay matrix and magnesite, feed for the V4's calcine charge. Not terminal: the V4 takes it.

PhobosStruvite.notes: LC-3 product, about 291 cr/kg: slow-release magnesium ammonium phosphate fertiliser, a small gain on its concentrate (1 October 2026). Never sold by merchants.

PhobosBrineSaltCake.notes: Terminal: the crust's sodium salts (halite, the sodium chloride made, trona, leftover thenardite, villiaumite).

PhobosCausticRemainder.notes: Terminal: the sodium hydroxide left by struvite precipitation.

PhobosCalcinedResidue.notes: Terminal: the leached residue's clay matrix with its magnesite calcined to magnesia.

PhobosSulfideNodule.notes: Mined, never sold: a troilite and schreibersite nodule of the kind found in iron meteorites (Buchwald 1975), carved from the meteoric-iron share of M-class and S-class finds; proportions authored. Sells like the game's hydrates.

PhobosPhosphoricAcidFlask.notes: SA-3 product: 0.515 kg of phosphoric acid in a sealed flask, the phosphorus of three struvite units, feed for the LC-3's acid-route struvite. 300 cr, so the nodule charge earns about twice its ore (1 October 2026). Never sold by merchants.

PhobosRoastedCalcine.notes: Terminal: the nodule's iron and nickel oxides and silicate after roasting.

PhobosEpsomSalt.notes: LC-3 product, about 30 cr/kg: magnesium sulfate heptahydrate from olivine leached in sulfuric acid, 0.432 kg (1.753 mol) so one unit carries the magnesium of one struvite unit. Priced so the olivine charge earns about 2.3 times its ore (1 October 2026). Never sold by merchants.

PhobosAmmoniumSulfate.notes: LC-3 product, about 86 cr/kg: the acid-route struvite's ammonium sulfate, 0.232 kg (1.756 mol), one unit beside each struvite unit. Keeps the acid-route step at about 1.3 times its inputs (1 October 2026). Never sold by merchants.

PhobosOlivineLeachCake.notes: Terminal: the olivine's silica gel, iron sulfate, undissolved rock and retained Epsom liquor.

PhobosNickelSteelIngot.notes: V4 product (Manufacturing 0.26.0): nickel steel carburised from four nickel-iron ingots and one carbon stock, the mined iron chain's own end product, 65 cr/kg so the chain earns about 2.2 times its ores (owner decision, 1 October 2026). Separate from Shipbreaker's plain steel ingot, which keeps its price and its F6 source.

PhobosCarbonBlack.notes: V4 product (Manufacturing 0.27.0): pyrolytic carbon black from methane cracked on a carbon bed, 12 cr/kg. Feed for the V4's carbon burner. Priced low on purpose: methane can be made from bought water and carbon dioxide through the X2 and K2, and at this price that route never pays (refining business rules, bought stock).

PhobosExhaustedSorbent.notes: Terminal (Manufacturing 0.27.0): the quarter of a batch of CO2 scrubber or EVA filter cartridges that reactivation cannot recover, shell and spent sorbent together.

PhobosPlantAsh.notes: Terminal (Manufacturing 0.37.0): the 30 g of mineral ash one straw bale leaves when the V4 burns or chars it.

PhobosSpentMash.notes: Terminal (Manufacturing 0.39.0): the 0.5 kg of pulp, unfermented sugar, yeast and water a fermenter-still charge leaves.

PhobosAlembrineSpirit.notes: Alembrine spirit (Manufacturing 0.40.0): one 35 g serving at 40% alcohol by volume, a clone of the game's vodka serving with its own identity. Priced in the refining band: a sugar beet rack's 31 servings (about 8 cr each) are worth about 1.9 times the crop's nutrients and water (owner decision, 4 October 2026: an own-brand spirit, not the game's 42.5 cr vodka). Not sold by any merchant.

PhobosWashedTailings.notes: Terminal (Manufacturing 0.44.0): what a gangue wash leaves, silicate fines and gypsum-like sulfates, in 1 kg units delivered as one stack. A declared remainder: the reaction mass feeder grinds it.
